stations.title: Dilys
stations.say: Can we each sign in as ourselves?

stations.title: Staff store
stations.text: Keeps exactly what it is given.

stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: Passwords would be kept as typed

captions: Dilys wants every member of staff at Kilnworth to sign in as themselves, not with one key.
Today a password would be saved exactly as it was typed, for anyone who sees the store.
You write a salted hash, a constant-time check, and staff saved without their password.
Now the store holds only a salted hash for Kofi, and his password still checks out.
The API can tell a right password from a wrong one without ever knowing either.
